### Figure 4 - breeding phenology effects
This figure reproduces the manuscript's breeding-phenology summary as three
single-predictor effect plots. The upper strip in each panel shows the observed
distribution of the phenology predictor, and the lower panel shows the
model-implied shift in molt midpoint. Because $t_0$ is a latent model parameter
rather than a directly observed point for each bird-season, this is preferable
to a raw scatterplot. Positive x-values denote the Table 1 direction: earlier
first breeding date, later last nest initiation date, and later last breeding
date.

```{r figure-5-breeding-phenology-effects, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8.5, fig.height=5}
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show code for Figure 4"
breeding_effect_plot_data <- bind_rows(lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(breeding_predictor_specs)),
  function(i) {
    spec_i <- breeding_predictor_specs[i, ]
    stats_i <- single_breeding_effect_summary_table %>%
      filter(predictor == spec_i$predictor)
    x_seq <- seq(
      min(dat_breeding_mod[[spec_i$predictor]], na.rm = TRUE),
      max(dat_breeding_mod[[spec_i$predictor]], na.rm = TRUE),
      length.out = 100
    ) * spec_i$multiplier

    tibble(
      predictor = spec_i$predictor,
      predictor_label = spec_i$display_label,
      phenology_shift = x_seq,
      estimate = stats_i$estimate,
      ci_lower = stats_i$ci_lower,
      ci_upper = stats_i$ci_upper,
      midpoint_shift = estimate * phenology_shift,
      midpoint_shift_lower = pmin(ci_lower * phenology_shift, ci_upper * phenology_shift),
      midpoint_shift_upper = pmax(ci_lower * phenology_shift, ci_upper * phenology_shift)
    )
  }
))

breeding_effect_observed_data <- bind_rows(lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(breeding_predictor_specs)),
  function(i) {
    spec_i <- breeding_predictor_specs[i, ]

    tibble(
      predictor = spec_i$predictor,
      predictor_label = spec_i$display_label,
      phenology_shift = dat_breeding_mod[[spec_i$predictor]] * spec_i$multiplier
    )
  }
))

breeding_effect_label_levels <- c(
  "First breeding date",
  "Last nest initiation date",
  "Last breeding date"
)

breeding_effect_plot_data <- breeding_effect_plot_data %>%
  mutate(predictor_label = factor(predictor_label, levels = breeding_effect_label_levels))

breeding_effect_distribution_data <- breeding_effect_observed_data %>%
  mutate(predictor_label = factor(predictor_label, levels = breeding_effect_label_levels)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(phenology_shift))

breeding_effect_x_limits <- range(
  c(
    breeding_effect_plot_data$phenology_shift,
    breeding_effect_distribution_data$phenology_shift
  ),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

breeding_effect_hist_breaks <- pretty(breeding_effect_x_limits, n = 18)
if (length(breeding_effect_hist_breaks) < 2) {
  breeding_effect_hist_breaks <- breeding_effect_x_limits + c(-0.5, 0.5)
}

breeding_effect_distribution_positions <- breeding_effect_distribution_data %>%
  group_by(predictor_label) %>%
  summarise(
    max_count = max(
      hist(phenology_shift, breaks = breeding_effect_hist_breaks, plot = FALSE)$counts,
      1,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

breeding_effect_distribution_y_anchor <- max(
  breeding_effect_distribution_positions$max_count,
  1,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

breeding_effect_distribution_positions <- breeding_effect_distribution_positions %>%
  mutate(
    point_y = breeding_effect_distribution_y_anchor * 1.25,
    box_y = breeding_effect_distribution_y_anchor * 1.55,
    y_max = breeding_effect_distribution_y_anchor * 1.8
  )

breeding_effect_distribution_data <- breeding_effect_distribution_data %>%
  left_join(breeding_effect_distribution_positions, by = "predictor_label")

breeding_effect_distribution_y_max <- max(
  breeding_effect_distribution_positions$y_max,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

breeding_effect_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "sans"),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, lineend = "round", colour = "grey90"),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, colour = "grey35"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

breeding_effect_distribution_plot <-
  ggplot(
    breeding_effect_distribution_data,
    aes(x = phenology_shift)
  ) +
  geom_histogram(
    aes(y = after_stat(count)),
    breaks = breeding_effect_hist_breaks,
    fill = "grey82",
    colour = NA,
    alpha = 0.55
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(y = point_y),
    colour = "grey50",
    alpha = 0.28,
    size = 1.1,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0,
      height = breeding_effect_distribution_y_max * 0.025,
      seed = 123
    )
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(y = box_y, group = predictor_label),
    orientation = "y",
    width = breeding_effect_distribution_y_max * 0.07,
    fill = "grey70",
    colour = "grey45",
    alpha = 0.35,
    linewidth = 0.35,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ predictor_label, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = breeding_effect_x_limits, expand = expansion(mult = 0.04), breaks = c(-60, -30, 0, 30, 60)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, breeding_effect_distribution_y_max),
    breaks = NULL,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.04))
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  breeding_effect_theme +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 0, 5.5)
  )

breeding_effect_slope_plot <-
  ggplot(
    breeding_effect_plot_data,
    aes(x = phenology_shift, y = midpoint_shift)
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey75") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey75") +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = midpoint_shift_lower, ymax = midpoint_shift_upper),
    fill = "grey75",
    alpha = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, colour = "grey25") +
  facet_wrap(~ predictor_label, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = breeding_effect_x_limits, expand = expansion(mult = 0.04), breaks = c(-60, -30, 0, 30, 60)) +
  labs(
    x = "Phenology shift (days)",
    y = "Predicted shift in post-breeding molt midpoint (days)",
    # caption = "Upper panels show the observed bird-season phenology distributions; lower panels show posterior median slopes from the single-predictor models with 95% CrIs."
  ) +
  breeding_effect_theme +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, lineend = "round", colour = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, lineend = "round", colour = "grey90"),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey35", hjust = 0)
  )

fig_4 <-
  breeding_effect_distribution_plot /
  breeding_effect_slope_plot +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.8, 3))


```

```{r}
  filename = "fig4.pdf",
  path = here("figs/"),
  device = cairo_pdf,
  width = 8.5,
  height = 7
)
```

## Supporting analyses referenced in the manuscript

### Is age associated with breeding phenology?
```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show code for data wrangle steps for analysis of age and breeding phenology"
# average ages excluding first year
avg_ages <-
  dat_breeding %>%
  distinct(rings_comb, age) %>%
  filter(!is.na(age)) %>%
  filter(age > 1) %>%
  group_by(rings_comb) %>%
  summarise(avg_age = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE))

# wrangle age-class breeding-phenology data
dat_age_class_breed <- dat_breeding %>%
  select(
    rings_comb, sex, age_class,
    last_breeding_date_J_snum,
    first_breeding_date_J_snum,
    last_nest_first_obs_J_snum
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  drop_na(
    rings_comb, sex, age_class,
    last_breeding_date_J_snum,
    first_breeding_date_J_snum,
    last_nest_first_obs_J_snum
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# wrangle AFY-only continuous-age breeding-phenology data
dat_age_breed <- dat_breeding %>%
  select(
    rings_comb, sex, age,
    last_breeding_date_J_snum,
    first_breeding_date_J_snum,
    last_nest_first_obs_J_snum
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(!is.na(age)) %>%
  filter(age > 1) %>%
  left_join(., avg_ages, by = "rings_comb") %>%
  mutate(age_dev = age - avg_age) %>%
  drop_na(
    rings_comb, sex, avg_age, age_dev,
    last_breeding_date_J_snum,
    first_breeding_date_J_snum,
    last_nest_first_obs_J_snum
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(
    rings_comb, sex, avg_age, age_dev,
    last_breeding_date_J_snum,
    first_breeding_date_J_snum,
    last_nest_first_obs_J_snum
  ) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Weakly-informative priors suitable for season-standardized outcomes
priors_gauss <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = "b"),          # fixed effects (incl. migratory_status)
  prior(normal(0, 5), class = "Intercept"),  # intercept
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd"),       # random effect SDs
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sigma")     # residual SD
)

# Age class (FY vs AFY), matching the main age-class moult model logic
mod_age_class_first_brms <- brm(
  first_breeding_date_J_snum ~ sex + age_class + (1 | rings_comb),
  data   = dat_age_class_breed,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior  = priors_gauss,
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 1000,
  seed   = 123
)

mod_age_class_last_brms <- brm(
  last_breeding_date_J_snum ~ sex + age_class + (1 | rings_comb),
  data   = dat_age_class_breed,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior  = priors_gauss,
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 1000,
  seed   = 123
)

mod_age_class_lay_brms <- brm(
  last_nest_first_obs_J_snum ~ sex + age_class + (1 | rings_comb),
  data   = dat_age_class_breed,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior  = priors_gauss,
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 1000,
  seed   = 123
)

# Continuous age among AFY birds only, matching the main AFY-only moult model logic
mod_age_first_brms <- brm(
  first_breeding_date_J_snum ~ sex + age_dev + avg_age + (1 | rings_comb),
  data   = dat_age_breed,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior  = priors_gauss,
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 1000,
  seed   = 123
)

mod_age_last_brms <- brm(
  last_breeding_date_J_snum ~ sex + age_dev + avg_age + (1 | rings_comb),
  data   = dat_age_breed,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior  = priors_gauss,
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 1000,
  seed   = 123
)

mod_age_lay_brms <- brm(
  last_nest_first_obs_J_snum ~ sex + age_dev + avg_age + (1 | rings_comb),
  data   = dat_age_breed,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior  = priors_gauss,
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 1000,
  seed   = 123
)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
summarise_breeding_age_class <- function(first_model, nest_model, last_model) {
  first_post <- as_draws_df(first_model$fitted_model)
  nest_post <- as_draws_df(nest_model$fitted_model)
  last_post <- as_draws_df(last_model$fitted_model)

  bind_rows(
    summary_row(
      "Δ first breeding date (AFY - FY; days)",
      "Posterior estimates (fixed effects)",
      "Age and breeding phenology",
      first_post$b_age_classAFY
    ),
    summary_row(
      "Δ last nest initiation date (AFY - FY; days)",
      "Posterior estimates (fixed effects)",
      "Age and breeding phenology",
      nest_post$b_age_classAFY
    ),
    summary_row(
      "Δ last breeding date (AFY - FY; days)",
      "Posterior estimates (fixed effects)",
      "Age and breeding phenology",
      last_post$b_age_classAFY
    )
  )
}

summarise_breeding_age_continuous <- function(first_model, nest_model, last_model) {
  first_post <- as_draws_df(first_model$fitted_model)
  nest_post <- as_draws_df(nest_model$fitted_model)
  last_post <- as_draws_df(last_model$fitted_model)

  bind_rows(
    summary_row(
      "Δ first breeding date per +1 year between-individual age (avg_age; days)",
      "Posterior estimates (fixed effects)",
      "Age and breeding phenology",
      first_post$b_avg_age
    ),
    summary_row(
      "Δ first breeding date per +1 year within-individual age (age_dev; days)",
      "Posterior estimates (fixed effects)",
      "Age and breeding phenology",
      first_post$b_age_dev
    ),
    summary_row(
      "Δ last nest initiation date per +1 year between-individual age (avg_age; days)",
      "Posterior estimates (fixed effects)",
      "Age and breeding phenology",
      nest_post$b_avg_age
    ),
    summary_row(
      "Δ last nest initiation date per +1 year within-individual age (age_dev; days)",
      "Posterior estimates (fixed effects)",
      "Age and breeding phenology",
      nest_post$b_age_dev
    ),
    summary_row(
      "Δ last breeding date per +1 year between-individual age (avg_age; days)",
      "Posterior estimates (fixed effects)",
      "Age and breeding phenology",
      last_post$b_avg_age
    ),
    summary_row(
      "Δ last breeding date per +1 year within-individual age (age_dev; days)",
      "Posterior estimates (fixed effects)",
      "Age and breeding phenology",
      last_post$b_age_dev
    )
  )
}
```

### Do known siblings show unusually similar molt phenotypes?
This exploratory analysis uses the trusted sibling pairs whose recruitment histories can be linked to uniquely coded nest IDs (`N11`, `N37`, `N39`, `N20`, and `N45`). To keep the phenotype estimates targeted to this question, we fit dedicated sibling-cohort models rather than borrowing posterior phenotypes from the full age-class model. The overall sibling model includes sex and age class as fixed effects, with season added to the `t0` submodel, and asks whether the observed sibling pairs are more similar than alternative pairings of the same 10 birds after controlling for those fixed effects. Separate FY-only and AFY-only sibling models then ask whether any sibling similarity is confined to the FY cohort or also appears among AFY siblings. Because the AFY birds were observed in multiple seasons, their sibling comparison is based on the posterior mean phenotype averaged across the seasons in which each bird was observed.

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show code for sibling-pair wrangle and sibling-model datasets"
sibling_pairs <- tibble(
  family_id = c("RB_FY", "RG_FY_A", "RG_FY_B", "RB_AFY", "RR_AFY"),
  bird_1 = c("RBWY", "RGGW", "RGOO", "RBBY", "RRBR"),
  bird_2 = c("RBYG", "RGGY", "RGOB", "RBRB", "RRBY"),
  cohort = c("FY", "FY", "FY", "AFY", "AFY"),
  trusted_nest_id = c("N11", "N39", "N37", "N20", "N45")
)

sibling_birds <- sort(unique(c(sibling_pairs$bird_1, sibling_pairs$bird_2)))

dat_sibling_all_mod <- dat_breeding %>%
  select(score, date_J, rings_comb, sex, season, age_class) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(rings_comb %in% sibling_birds) %>%
  add_reference_date_scaling() %>%
  drop_na(score, date_J_scaled, rings_comb, sex, season, age_class) %>%
  as.data.frame()

dat_sibling_fy_mod <- dat_sibling_all_mod %>%
  filter(age_class == "FY") %>%
  as.data.frame()

dat_sibling_afy_mod <- dat_sibling_all_mod %>%
  filter(age_class == "AFY") %>%
  as.data.frame()

mod_sibling_all <- bf(
  score ~ 1 + (baseline - 1) * (1 - 1 / (1 + exp(-k * (date_J_scaled - t0)))),
  baseline ~ sex + age_class + (1 | i | rings_comb) + (1 | rings_comb:season),
  t0 ~ sex + season + age_class + (1 | i | rings_comb) + (1 | rings_comb:season),
  k ~ 1,
  nl = TRUE
)

mod_sibling_fy <- bf(
  score ~ 1 + (baseline - 1) * (1 - 1 / (1 + exp(-k * (date_J_scaled - t0)))),
  baseline ~ sex + (1 | i | rings_comb),
  t0 ~ sex + (1 | i | rings_comb),
  k ~ 1,
  nl = TRUE
)

mod_sibling_afy <- bf(
  score ~ 1 + (baseline - 1) * (1 - 1 / (1 + exp(-k * (date_J_scaled - t0)))),
  baseline ~ sex + (1 | i | rings_comb) + (1 | rings_comb:season),
  t0 ~ sex + season + (1 | i | rings_comb) + (1 | rings_comb:season),
  k ~ 1,
  nl = TRUE
)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(

)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
pair_key <- function(a, b) {
  paste(pmin(a, b), pmax(a, b), sep = "__")
}

generate_perfect_matchings <- function(ids) {
  if (length(ids) == 0) {
    return(list(list()))
  }

  first_id <- ids[[1]]
  out <- list()

  for (i in 2:length(ids)) {
    pair_i <- c(first_id, ids[[i]])
    remaining_ids <- ids[-c(1, i)]
    sub_matchings <- generate_perfect_matchings(remaining_ids)

    for (j in seq_along(sub_matchings)) {
      out[[length(out) + 1]] <- c(list(pair_i), sub_matchings[[j]])
    }
  }

  out
}

build_sibling_bird_phenotypes <- function(model_obj, bird_ids) {
  post <- as_draws_df(model_obj$fitted_model)
  re_list <- brms::ranef(model_obj$fitted_model, summary = FALSE)
  has_bird_season <- "rings_comb:season" %in% names(re_list)

  bird_info <- model_obj$data %>%
    select(any_of(c(
      "rings_comb", "season", "sex", "age_class",
      "date_J_mean_ref", "date_J_sd_ref"
    ))) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    filter(rings_comb %in% bird_ids) %>%
    arrange(match(rings_comb, bird_ids), season)

  if (!"age_class" %in% names(bird_info)) {
    bird_info$age_class <- NA_character_
  }

  if (!all(c("date_J_mean_ref", "date_J_sd_ref") %in% names(bird_info))) {
    bird_info <- bird_info %>%
      select(-any_of(c("date_J_mean_ref", "date_J_sd_ref"))) %>%
      left_join(date_scaling_ref, by = "season")
  }

  baseline_bird_season <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(bird_info)), function(i) {
    row_i <- bird_info[i, ]
    bird_id <- as.character(row_i$rings_comb)
    out <- post$b_baseline_Intercept

    out <- out + re_list$rings_comb[, bird_id, "baseline_Intercept"]

    if (has_bird_season) {
      bird_season_id <- paste0(bird_id, "_", row_i$season)
      out <- out + re_list$`rings_comb:season`[, bird_season_id, "baseline_Intercept"]
    }

    out
  })

  t0_bird_season <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(bird_info)), function(i) {
    row_i <- bird_info[i, ]
    bird_id <- as.character(row_i$rings_comb)
    out <- post$b_t0_Intercept

    out <- out + re_list$rings_comb[, bird_id, "t0_Intercept"]

    if (has_bird_season) {
      bird_season_id <- paste0(bird_id, "_", row_i$season)
      out <- out + re_list$`rings_comb:season`[, bird_season_id, "t0_Intercept"]
    }

    out * row_i$date_J_sd_ref + row_i$date_J_mean_ref
  })

  baseline_bird <- sapply(bird_ids, function(bird_id) {
    rowMeans(
      baseline_bird_season[, bird_info$rings_comb == bird_id, drop = FALSE]
    )
  })

  t0_bird <- sapply(bird_ids, function(bird_id) {
    rowMeans(
      t0_bird_season[, bird_info$rings_comb == bird_id, drop = FALSE]
    )
  })

  dimnames(baseline_bird) <- list(NULL, bird_ids)
  dimnames(t0_bird) <- list(NULL, bird_ids)

  list(
    bird_info = bird_info,
    baseline_bird = baseline_bird,
    t0_bird = t0_bird
  )
}

summarise_sibling_similarity <- function(
    bird_ids,
    sibling_pairs_subset,
    baseline_draws_mat,
    t0_draws_mat,
    cohort_label) {
  cohort_pairs_mat <- t(combn(bird_ids, 2))
  cohort_pairs <- tibble(
    bird_1 = cohort_pairs_mat[, 1],
    bird_2 = cohort_pairs_mat[, 2]
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      pair_label = paste(bird_1, bird_2, sep = " vs "),
      pair_key = pair_key(bird_1, bird_2),
      is_sibling = pair_key %in% pair_key(sibling_pairs_subset$bird_1, sibling_pairs_subset$bird_2)
    )

  baseline_pair_draws <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(cohort_pairs)), function(i) {
    abs(
      baseline_draws_mat[, cohort_pairs$bird_1[[i]]] -
        baseline_draws_mat[, cohort_pairs$bird_2[[i]]]
    )
  })

  t0_pair_draws <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(cohort_pairs)), function(i) {
    abs(
      t0_draws_mat[, cohort_pairs$bird_1[[i]]] -
        t0_draws_mat[, cohort_pairs$bird_2[[i]]]
    )
  })

  cohort_pair_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(cohort_pairs)), function(i) {
    tibble(
      cohort = cohort_label,
      pair_label = cohort_pairs$pair_label[[i]],
      is_sibling = cohort_pairs$is_sibling[[i]],
      baseline_distance = format_numeric_interval(
        summarise_posterior(baseline_pair_draws[, i])
      ),
      t0_distance = format_numeric_interval(summarise_posterior(t0_pair_draws[, i]))
    )
  })) %>%
    filter(is_sibling)

  cohort_matchings <- generate_perfect_matchings(bird_ids)
  cohort_pair_index_lookup <- setNames(seq_len(nrow(cohort_pairs)), cohort_pairs$pair_key)

  cohort_matching_index_list <- lapply(cohort_matchings, function(matching_i) {
    pair_ids_i <- sapply(matching_i, function(pair_i) pair_key(pair_i[[1]], pair_i[[2]]))
    unname(cohort_pair_index_lookup[pair_ids_i])
  })

  cohort_matching_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(cohort_matching_index_list), function(i) {
    pair_ids_i <- cohort_pairs$pair_key[cohort_matching_index_list[[i]]]

    tibble(
      matching_id = i,
      matching_key = paste(sort(pair_ids_i), collapse = " | ")
    )
  }))

  observed_sibling_matching_key <- sibling_pairs_subset %>%
    mutate(pair_key = pair_key(bird_1, bird_2)) %>%
    summarise(matching_key = paste(sort(pair_key), collapse = " | ")) %>%
    pull(matching_key)

  observed_matching_id <- cohort_matching_summary %>%
    filter(matching_key == observed_sibling_matching_key) %>%
    pull(matching_id)

  baseline_matching_draws <- sapply(cohort_matching_index_list, function(idx) {
    rowMeans(baseline_pair_draws[, idx, drop = FALSE])
  })

  t0_matching_draws <- sapply(cohort_matching_index_list, function(idx) {
    rowMeans(t0_pair_draws[, idx, drop = FALSE])
  })

  observed_baseline_matching <- baseline_matching_draws[, observed_matching_id]
  observed_t0_matching <- t0_matching_draws[, observed_matching_id]

  alternative_baseline_matching <- rowMeans(
    baseline_matching_draws[, -observed_matching_id, drop = FALSE]
  )
  alternative_t0_matching <- rowMeans(
    t0_matching_draws[, -observed_matching_id, drop = FALSE]
  )

  observed_baseline_stats <- summarise_posterior(observed_baseline_matching)
  observed_t0_stats <- summarise_posterior(observed_t0_matching)
  alternative_baseline_stats <- summarise_posterior(alternative_baseline_matching)
  alternative_t0_stats <- summarise_posterior(alternative_t0_matching)
  baseline_difference <- observed_baseline_matching - alternative_baseline_matching
  t0_difference <- observed_t0_matching - alternative_t0_matching
  baseline_difference_stats <- summarise_posterior(baseline_difference)
  t0_difference_stats <- summarise_posterior(t0_difference)
  baseline_prob_more_similar <- mean(observed_baseline_matching < alternative_baseline_matching)
  t0_prob_more_similar <- mean(observed_t0_matching < alternative_t0_matching)

  cohort_similarity_summary <- tibble(
    cohort = cohort_label,
    trait = c("Baseline expression (adjusted)", "Molt midpoint (t0, adjusted)"),
    observed_sibling_matching = c(
      format_numeric_interval(observed_baseline_stats),
      format_numeric_interval(observed_t0_stats)
    ),
    average_alternative_matching = c(
      format_numeric_interval(alternative_baseline_stats),
      format_numeric_interval(alternative_t0_stats)
    ),
    sibling_minus_alternative = c(
      format_numeric_interval(baseline_difference_stats),
      format_numeric_interval(t0_difference_stats)
    ),
    prob_siblings_more_similar = c(
      baseline_prob_more_similar,
      t0_prob_more_similar
    ),
    prob_siblings_closest_matching = c(
      mean(apply(baseline_matching_draws, 1, which.min) == observed_matching_id),
      mean(apply(t0_matching_draws, 1, which.min) == observed_matching_id)
    ),
    n_matchings = c(ncol(baseline_matching_draws), ncol(t0_matching_draws))
  )

  cohort_matching_interval_df <- bind_rows(
    observed_baseline_stats %>%
      transmute(
        cohort = cohort_label,
        trait = "Baseline expression (adjusted)",
        comparison = "Observed sibling matching",
        estimate = median,
        ci_lower = ci_lower,
        ci_upper = ci_upper,
        prob_siblings_more_similar = baseline_prob_more_similar
      ),
    alternative_baseline_stats %>%
      transmute(
        cohort = cohort_label,
        trait = "Baseline expression (adjusted)",
        comparison = "Average alternative matching",
        estimate = median,
        ci_lower = ci_lower,
        ci_upper = ci_upper,
        prob_siblings_more_similar = baseline_prob_more_similar
      ),
    observed_t0_stats %>%
      transmute(
        cohort = cohort_label,
        trait = "Molt midpoint (t0, adjusted)",
        comparison = "Observed sibling matching",
        estimate = median,
        ci_lower = ci_lower,
        ci_upper = ci_upper,
        prob_siblings_more_similar = t0_prob_more_similar
      ),
    alternative_t0_stats %>%
      transmute(
        cohort = cohort_label,
        trait = "Molt midpoint (t0, adjusted)",
        comparison = "Average alternative matching",
        estimate = median,
        ci_lower = ci_lower,
        ci_upper = ci_upper,
        prob_siblings_more_similar = t0_prob_more_similar
      )
  )

  cohort_matching_annotation_df <- tibble(
    cohort = cohort_label,
    trait = c("Baseline expression (adjusted)", "Molt midpoint (t0, adjusted)"),
    prob_siblings_more_similar = c(
      baseline_prob_more_similar,
      t0_prob_more_similar
    ),
    difference = c(
      format_numeric_interval(baseline_difference_stats),
      format_numeric_interval(t0_difference_stats)
    ),
    label = sprintf("Pr(observed < alternative) = %.2f", prob_siblings_more_similar)
  )

  cohort_matching_draw_df <- bind_rows(
    tibble(
      cohort = cohort_label,
      trait = "Baseline expression (adjusted)",
      comparison = "Observed sibling matching",
      draw_id = seq_along(observed_baseline_matching),
      estimate = observed_baseline_matching
    ),
    tibble(
      cohort = cohort_label,
      trait = "Baseline expression (adjusted)",
      comparison = "Average alternative matching",
      draw_id = seq_along(alternative_baseline_matching),
      estimate = alternative_baseline_matching
    ),
    tibble(
      cohort = cohort_label,
      trait = "Molt midpoint (t0, adjusted)",
      comparison = "Observed sibling matching",
      draw_id = seq_along(observed_t0_matching),
      estimate = observed_t0_matching
    ),
    tibble(
      cohort = cohort_label,
      trait = "Molt midpoint (t0, adjusted)",
      comparison = "Average alternative matching",
      draw_id = seq_along(alternative_t0_matching),
      estimate = alternative_t0_matching
    )
  )

  cohort_matching_plot_df <- bind_rows(
    tibble(
      cohort = cohort_label,
      trait = "Baseline expression (adjusted)",
      matching_id = cohort_matching_summary$matching_id,
      estimate = apply(baseline_matching_draws, 2, median),
      is_observed_sibling_matching = cohort_matching_summary$matching_id == observed_matching_id
    ),
    tibble(
      cohort = cohort_label,
      trait = "Molt midpoint (t0, adjusted)",
      matching_id = cohort_matching_summary$matching_id,
      estimate = apply(t0_matching_draws, 2, median),
      is_observed_sibling_matching = cohort_matching_summary$matching_id == observed_matching_id
    )
  )

  list(
    pair_summary = cohort_pair_summary,
    similarity_summary = cohort_similarity_summary,
    matching_plot_df = cohort_matching_plot_df,
    matching_interval_df = cohort_matching_interval_df,
    matching_annotation_df = cohort_matching_annotation_df,
    matching_draw_df = cohort_matching_draw_df
  )
}

    sibling_similarity_all$matching_interval_df,
    sibling_similarity_fy$matching_interval_df,
    sibling_similarity_afy$matching_interval_df
  )

  sibling_matching_annotation_df <- bind_rows(
    sibling_similarity_all$matching_annotation_df,
    sibling_similarity_fy$matching_annotation_df,
    sibling_similarity_afy$matching_annotation_df
  )

  sibling_matching_draw_df <- bind_rows(
    sibling_similarity_all$matching_draw_df,
    sibling_similarity_fy$matching_draw_df,
    sibling_similarity_afy$matching_draw_df
  )
}
```

#### Summary table: observed sibling matching versus alternative pairings
```{r, echo=FALSE}
if (exists("sibling_similarity_summary")) {

      ) %>%
      select(
```

#### Plot: observed sibling matching against all alternative matchings
```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
if (exists("sibling_matching_plot_df")) {
  sibling_matching_plot_df_all <- sibling_matching_plot_df %>%
    filter(cohort == "All sibling birds")

  sibling_matching_interval_df_all <- sibling_matching_interval_df %>%
    filter(cohort == "All sibling birds") %>%
    mutate(
      x_position = case_when(
        comparison == "Average alternative matching" ~ 1,
        comparison == "Observed sibling matching" ~ 2,
        TRUE ~ 1
      )
    )

  sibling_matching_draw_df_all <- sibling_matching_draw_df %>%
    filter(cohort == "All sibling birds") %>%
    mutate(
      x_position = case_when(
        comparison == "Average alternative matching" ~ 1,
        comparison == "Observed sibling matching" ~ 2,
        TRUE ~ 1
      )
    )

  sibling_matching_annotation_df_all <- sibling_matching_annotation_df %>%
    filter(cohort == "All sibling birds")

  sibling_matching_y_ranges <- bind_rows(
    sibling_matching_plot_df_all %>%
      transmute(trait, y_value = estimate),
    sibling_matching_draw_df_all %>%
      transmute(trait, y_value = estimate),
    sibling_matching_interval_df_all %>%
      transmute(trait, y_value = ci_lower),
    sibling_matching_interval_df_all %>%
      transmute(trait, y_value = ci_upper)
  ) %>%
    group_by(trait) %>%
    summarise(
      y_min = min(y_value, na.rm = TRUE),
      y_max = max(y_value, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      y_range = y_max - y_min,
      y_label = y_max - 0.08 * y_range
    )

  sibling_matching_annotation_df_all <- sibling_matching_annotation_df_all %>%
    left_join(sibling_matching_y_ranges, by = "trait") %>%
    mutate(
      x_position = 1.5,
      label = label
    )

  sibling_matching_y_labels <- c(
    "Baseline expression (adjusted)" =
      "Mean pairwise distance in baseline expression (sex-adjusted)",
    "Molt midpoint (t0, adjusted)" =
      "Mean pairwise distance in molt midpoint timing (sex-adjusted)"
  )

  make_sibling_matching_panel <- function(trait_i, y_label_i) {
    # The violins are posterior draws for the observed sibling matching and
    # the average alternative matching. The grey points are medians for each
    # individual alternative matching, so they are not expected to have the
    # same spread as the average-alternative posterior.
    ggplot() +
      geom_violin(
        data = sibling_matching_draw_df_all %>%
          filter(trait == trait_i),
        aes(
          x = x_position,
          y = estimate,
          group = comparison,
          fill = comparison
        ),
        width = 0.55,
        trim = FALSE,
        alpha = 0.35,
        colour = NA
      ) +
      geom_jitter(
        data = sibling_matching_plot_df_all %>%
          filter(trait == trait_i, !is_observed_sibling_matching),
        aes(x = 1, y = estimate, colour = "Individual alternative matchings"),
        width = 0.11,
        shape = 16,
        size = 1.6,
        alpha = 0.32
      ) +
      geom_errorbar(
        data = sibling_matching_interval_df_all %>%
          filter(trait == trait_i),
        aes(
          x = x_position,
          ymin = ci_lower,
          ymax = ci_upper,
          colour = comparison
        ),
        width = 0.04,
        linewidth = 0.65,
        alpha = 0.95
      ) +
      geom_point(
        data = sibling_matching_interval_df_all %>%
          filter(trait == trait_i, comparison == "Average alternative matching"),
        aes(x = x_position, y = estimate, colour = comparison),
        shape = 18,
        size = 3.5,
        alpha = 1
      ) +
      geom_point(
        data = sibling_matching_interval_df_all %>%
          filter(trait == trait_i, comparison == "Observed sibling matching"),
        aes(x = x_position, y = estimate),
        shape = 21,
        size = 4,
        fill = "#B24745",
        colour = "black",
        stroke = 0.45,
        show.legend = FALSE
      ) +
      geom_point(
        data = sibling_matching_interval_df_all %>%
          filter(trait == trait_i, comparison == "Observed sibling matching"),
        aes(x = x_position, y = estimate, colour = comparison),
        shape = 16,
        size = 2.5,
        alpha = 1
      ) +
      geom_text(
        data = sibling_matching_annotation_df_all %>%
          filter(trait == trait_i),
        aes(x = x_position, y = y_label, label = label),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 3,
        lineheight = 0.95,
        colour = "grey25"
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = c(1, 2),
        labels = c("Alternative\nmatchings", "Observed\nsiblings"),
        limits = c(0.55, 2.45)
      ) +
      scale_colour_manual(
        values = c(
          "Individual alternative matchings" = "grey72",
          "Average alternative matching" = "grey25",
          "Observed sibling matching" = "#B24745"
        ),
        name = ""
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c(
          "Average alternative matching" = "grey55",
          "Observed sibling matching" = "#B24745"
        ),
        guide = "none"
      ) +
      labs(
        x = "",
        y = y_label_i
      ) +
      luke_theme +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.position = "top"
      )
  }

  sibling_matching_plot <-
    make_sibling_matching_panel(
      "Baseline expression (adjusted)",
      sibling_matching_y_labels[["Baseline expression (adjusted)"]]
    ) +
    make_sibling_matching_panel(
      "Molt midpoint (t0, adjusted)",
      sibling_matching_y_labels[["Molt midpoint (t0, adjusted)"]]
    ) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank()
    )

  sibling_matching_plot

  ggsave(
    plot = sibling_matching_plot,
    filename = "FigS2.pdf",
    path = here("figs/"),
    device = cairo_pdf,
    width = 8,
    height = 8
  )
}
```

### Is sex composition independent of age class?
Yes
```{r}
sex_age_class_mod <- readRDS(here("out/sex_age_class_mod_2.rds"))
sex_age <-
  sex_age_class_mod$data %>%
  distinct(rings_comb, sex, age_class) %>%
  group_by(rings_comb) %>%
  arrange(desc(age_class)) %>%
  slice(1)

tab_sex_age <- table(
  sex_age$sex,
  sex_age$age_class
)

fisher.test(tab_sex_age)
```

### Is sex composition independent of migratory status?
Yes
```{r}
sex_migratory_status_mod <- readRDS(here("out/sex_migratory_status_mod_.rds"))

sex_mig <-
  sex_migratory_status_mod$data %>%
  select(rings_comb, sex, migratory_status) %>%
  distinct()

tab_sex_mig <- table(
  sex_mig$sex,
  sex_mig$migratory_status
)

fisher.test(tab_sex_mig)
```

## Reproducibility details

This Quarto document can be reproduced in two ways. Rendering from the saved
objects in `out/` reproduces the manuscript tables and figures without
re-fitting the Bayesian models. Full refitting is also documented here, but it
additionally requires `cmdstanr`, a working CmdStan installation, and the
`eval=FALSE` model-fitting chunks retained above.

### Software summary

```{r reproducibility-software, echo=FALSE}
reproducibility_software <- tibble(
  component = c(
    "R version",
    "Platform",
    "Operating system",
    "Document date",
    "Project root"
  ),
  value = c(
    R.version.string,
    R.version$platform,
    paste(Sys.info()[["sysname"]], Sys.info()[["release"]]),
    "August 7, 2026",
    here::here()
  )
)

knitr::kable(
  reproducibility_software,
  align = c("l", "l")
)
```

### Package manifest

The table below lists the packages used by the document, together with the
installed version detected at render time. Packages marked as "refit only" are
not needed to regenerate the manuscript outputs from the saved `.rds` objects,
but they are needed if a reader wants to rerun the `brms` fitting steps.

```{r reproducibility-packages, echo=FALSE}
installed_pkg_tbl <-
  as_tibble(installed.packages(), rownames = "package") %>%
  select(package, Version)

package_manifest <-
  bind_rows(
    tibble(
      package = packages_required_in_project,
      role = "render"
    ),
    tibble(
      package = optional_packages_for_refitting,
      role = "refit only"
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(installed_pkg_tbl, by = "package") %>%
  mutate(
    installed = if_else(is.na(Version), "no", "yes"),
    Version = replace_na(Version, "not installed")
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(role, c("render", "refit only")), package)

knitr::kable(
  package_manifest,
  col.names = c("Package", "Role", "Installed", "Version"),
  align = c("l", "l", "c", "l")
)
```

These are the tracked input files used directly by the current manuscript

### Optional refitting settings

All `brms` models in this document are fitted with four chains. The main molt
models use 10,000 iterations per chain with 5,000 warmup iterations and
`backend = "cmdstanr"`. The supporting Gaussian breeding-phenology and sibling
models use 4,000 iterations per chain with 1,000 warmup iterations. The seeds
used in the current source are listed below so a reader can refit with the same
random-number initialization.

```{r reproducibility-refit-settings, echo=FALSE}
refit_settings <-
  tribble(
    ~analysis, ~output_file, ~seed, ~iter, ~warmup, ~notes,
    "Sex-specific molt model", "out/sex_mod_.rds", 123, 10000, 5000, "Main manuscript model",
    "First breeding date molt model", "out/sex_first_breed_only_mod_.rds", 141, 10000, 5000, "Single-predictor breeding-phenology model",
    "Last breeding date molt model", "out/sex_last_breed_only_mod_.rds", 142, 10000, 5000, "Single-predictor breeding-phenology model",
    "Last nest initiation molt model", "out/sex_last_nest_first_obs_only_mod_.rds", 143, 10000, 5000, "Single-predictor breeding-phenology model",
    "Age-class molt model", "out/sex_age_class_mod_2.rds", 123, 10000, 5000, "Main manuscript model",
    "Continuous-age molt model", "out/sex_age_avg_mod_.rds", 123, 10000, 5000, "Main manuscript model",
    "Migratory-strategy molt model", "out/sex_migratory_status_mod_.rds", 123, 10000, 5000, "Main manuscript model",
    "Age-class breeding phenology models", "out/mod_age_class_{first,lay,last}_brms_.rds", 123, 4000, 1000, "Supporting manuscript check",
    "Continuous-age breeding phenology models", "out/mod_age_{first,lay,last}_brms_.rds", 123, 4000, 1000, "Supporting manuscript check",
    "Sibling model: all trusted sibling birds", "out/sex_sibling_all_mod_.rds", 601, 4000, 1000, "Supplementary Figure S2",
    "Sibling model: FY birds", "out/sex_sibling_fy_mod_.rds", 602, 4000, 1000, "Supplementary Figure S2",
    "Sibling model: AFY birds", "out/sex_sibling_afy_mod_.rds", 603, 4000, 1000, "Supplementary Figure S2"
  )

knitr::kable(
  refit_settings,
  col.names = c("Analysis", "Output file", "Seed", "Iterations", "Warmup", "Notes"),
  align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "l")
)
```
